title: The Thorn of Ashvale Anew
author: Felix Underhill
blurb: Isandro Delacroix, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
